name: Arjun K B
bio: Building enterprise SAP applications and modern web solutions with ABAP, React, Node.js and modern development technologies.
aboutBio: I am an SAP ABAP Developer experienced in building enterprise applications, interactive reports, workflows, and custom SAP solutions. My primary expertise includes Module Pool programming, ALV reporting, Open SQL queries, ABAP Dictionary design, and Smart Forms development.

I frequently collaborate with functional consultants to translate business requirements into efficient SAP solutions. Alongside my SAP expertise, I possess strong full-stack web development capabilities with React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
I take pride in writing clean, optimized code, debugging complex business scenarios, and building practical technology solutions across enterprise SAP and modern web stacks.
services: SAP ABAP Enterprise Development — Module Pool, ALV Reports & Smart Forms
Open SQL & ABAP Dictionary Table / Data Structure Design
Full-Stack Web Solutions with React, Node.js & REST APIs
Embedded Systems & Hardware Integration (ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi)
